title: Learning-Augmented Algorithms: Guarantees, Construction Mechanisms, and System-Level Implications
abstract: arXiv:2609.04787v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning-augmented algorithms use fallible predictions while retaining formal performance guarantees. This survey synthesizes prediction interfaces, error measures, consistency--robustness trade-offs, and five representative construction mechanisms across online optimization, caching, learned data structures, graph problems, and mechanism design. An orthogonal theorem-level axis distinguishes achieved upper bounds from matched asymptotic dependence. Formal guarantees are separated from empirical systems evidence, with explicit treatment of prediction cost, feedback, and composition. The resulting synthesis states sufficient conditions for limited end-to-end reasoning and delineates open problems in cost-aware prediction, endogenous error, semantic predictors, and benchmarking.

translated_title: 学习增强算法：性能保证、构造机制与系统级意义
translated_abstract: 学习增强算法在利用可能出错的预测的同时保持正式的性能保证。本综述综合梳理了预测接口、误差度量、一致性—鲁棒性权衡，以及涵盖在线优化、缓存、学习型数据结构、图问题和机制设计等领域的五种代表性构造机制。综述还引入了一个正交的定理层面维度，用于区分所达到的上界与匹配的渐近依赖关系。正式的理论保证与实证系统证据被分开处理，并对预测成本、反馈和组合进行了明确分析。由此形成的综合性阐述给出了有限端到端推理的充分条件，并勾画了成本感知预测、内生误差、语义预测器和基准测试方面的开放问题。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了学习增强算法领域的预测接口、误差度量、一致性—鲁棒性权衡及五种代表性构造机制，明确区分形式化保证与实证系统证据，并指出了该领域的未来开放问题。
en_tdlr: This survey synthesizes prediction interfaces, error measures, consistency-robustness trade-offs, and five representative construction mechanisms in learning-augmented algorithms, distinguishing formal guarantees from empirical systems evidence and outlining key open research problems.
